torments.name: Final Judgment
torments.description: Enemies will be more challenging. Falling into chasms and thorns will lead to instant death.

torments.name: Vow of Poverty
torments.description: Fervor and rosary beads upgrades will remain locked.

torments.name: Spilled Blood
torments.description: Your health bar will be replaced by life orbs.

torments.name: Chalice of Guilt
torments.description: When you die, you will drop a single Guilt Fragment that will contain half of the Tears of Atonement and experience obtained.

torments.name: Ascension of Penance
torments.description: Any hit you receive will increase your Guilt. In exchange, your attacks will be more powerful when you are free from Guilt.

torments.name: Peace for the Remorseful
torments.description: Enemies will reappear if you leave and then return to their room. In exchange, you will have additional resistance to all elements.

torments.name: Barefoot Procession
torments.description: Any hit you receive will deplete your fervor bar. In exchange, fervor gains will increase.

torments.name: Endless Thirst
torments.description: You gain less experience in combat and will collect fewer Marks of Martyrdom. In exchange, the Altarpiece of Favours will be completely unlocked from the start.

torments.name: Ultimate Torment
torments.description: Your penance starts again. You will lose all obtained items, weapons and upgrades from your previous playthrough. This challenge cannot be disabled.
